name: startup-variant-builds
command:
set -e
node bench/freeze-startup-variants.mjs build/startup-variants-v1
for startup_words in 16384 65536 262144; do
  for startup_layout in shift direct; do
    node bench/build-experiment.mjs build/startup-variants-v1/legacy-$startup_words/bench/advanced-legacy-$startup_layout.bend build/startup-legacy-$startup_layout-$startup_words
  done
done
for startup_words in 65536 262144; do
  node bench/build-experiment.mjs build/startup-variants-v1/word-$startup_words/bench/advanced-main.bend build/startup-word-direct-$startup_words
done
node bench/build-experiment.mjs bench/fixed-work.bend build/startup-fixed-current
node tests/fixed-work-native.mjs build/startup-fixed-current

limits.enforcement: transient user cgroup scope: MemoryMax, no swap; taskset; timeout; CPU rlimit; aggregate RSS backstop
